newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand postpones ASEM finmin meet in Bangkok.
newsitem.headline: Thailand postpones ASEM finmin meet in Bangkok.

text.p: Thailand said on Thursday it decided to postpone a meeting of finance ministers from Asia and Europe due to anticipated government changes following the Thai general election next month.
The meeting was originally scheduled for late November or early December.

Finance ministry officials said Thailand's decision to delay the meeting, a follow-up of an Asia-Europe summit (ASEM) in Bangkok last March, would give a newly-elected Thai government more time to arrange the meeting.

They said Japan, which had an election this week, would also need time for its finance minister to prepare for the meeting which is designed to discuss broad trade and investment cooperation among countries of the two economic blocs.
The officials said the one-day meeting is rescheduled for September 26, 1997.
